content:
Hello everyone! I am a second year Mathematics and Computer Science undergraduate at the University of Liverpool. I'm mainly interested in pure mathematics, and I'm also interested in theoretical computer science and cryptography.

I'm new to Lean and want to learn how to use it to formalise mathematics and contribute to collaborative projects. I'd love to build towards contributing to research over time.

I would be grateful for any recommendations for beginner friendly projects, open problems, or ways to get involved with the community! Even if this comes in the shape of an informal chat, I am looking forward to hearing and learning from you!

Take some nice theorem from your second year notes and try to state it and then prove it! You can use AI to help you state it (stating theorems is hard for beginners and there are gotchas) but if you want to actually learn how to use lean then I strongly recommend not using AI to prove it (as then all you'll learn is that AI can formalise undergraduate mathematics, which we all know)
